learning_goal: Explain why a rectangle with 4 columns and 3 rows has area 12 square units.
source_text: Create a small lesson with exactly one short Manim worked example and one interactive multiple-choice check. In the worked example show a rectangle tiled with 4 columns and 3 rows of unit squares, identify length 4 and width 3, and explain area = 4 × 3 = 12 square units. Then ask for the area of a rectangle of length 5 and width 2. Keep narration concise. No extra opener or closer scenes.
